questions.text: Emergency contact numbers listed in personnel files must remain _____ even when an employee moves or transfers to another department.

Because the driver's account of the damage differed from the repair shop's report, the claims office could not _____ a final decision until an inspector examined the vehicle.
Because the first two lunchtime seminars attracted far more staff than the department had expected, the training coordinator has scheduled a third session in the hope of an equally _____ outcome.
Because the reception desk is unstaffed between noon and one o'clock each day, the assistant seated nearest the main entrance accepts full _____ for receiving deliveries and greeting visitors.
With the number of employees cycling to work rising each month, the facilities office now treats covered bicycle parking as a basic _____ rather than an optional extra.
With renewal requests now arriving at all hours, the library has upgraded its automated telephone line to _____ borrowers who call long after the building has closed.
Because the vacant position involves access to confidential client files, written _____ from two previous supervisors are carefully reviewed before any offer is extended.
Since entry cards are frequently misplaced, the membership office now charges a small fee for each additional _____ issued within the same calendar year.
Under the revised payroll procedure, employees _____ recorded hours differ from the posted schedule must submit a signed correction form before Thursday afternoon.
Because the packing line cannot run while its conveyor belt is being replaced, the maintenance crew will complete the work overnight on Saturday to keep production downtime to a _____.
Because hotels abroad frequently require a deposit at check-in, employees traveling overseas are now routinely _____ with a company payment card before departure.
Beginning next month, leasing agents must _____ all appointment times with the current tenant before showing an occupied apartment to prospective renters.
Because several rush orders are often packed side by side in the same area, every carton must be _____ labeled with the buyer's account number before it leaves the loading dock.
Now that the company portal lets employees reset forgotten passwords on their own, the technology support team spends far less time answering routine _____ from staff about account access.
Subscribers who do not recognize a charge on their monthly bill may ask the billing office for a full _____ of the individual fees applied during the previous month.
While the rear parking area is being resurfaced this month, the afternoon shuttle will collect passengers at a temporary _____ marked beside the main lobby entrance.
The tree-planting dates now posted on the parks department's website remain _____ because several local schools have not yet confirmed how many students will take part.
The supply coordinator keeps four spare toner cartridges _____ so that a heavy printing week never leaves the third-floor copy room without supplies.
